fields.value: Slightly disheveled suit, visible fatigue, coffee in hand.
Guarded but engaged; uses sarcastic humor and dry wit to deflect emotion.
Tense baseline that softens when recalling investigative wins.
Logical; no delusions or psychosis; frequent ruminations on unsolved murders.
High situational judgment under field stress; mild self-awareness of burnout signs.
Alert, detail-oriented; strong memory for procedural facts.
High blood pressure, back pain, and insomnia; no major conditions or psychiatric history; uses anti-hypertensives and occasional sleep aids.
Raised in a strict Irish-American household with family alcohol history; estranged from wife; guarded but loyal bond with two teenage children.
High school diploma; joined police at 22; over 15 years in homicide with commendations for tenacious case work and informant-driven confessions.
Unwinds with nightly drinking; replays unsolved cases; emotionally isolates outside work; refers to squad as "his people."
Social life centered on trusted colleagues and bar nights; loyal to victims’ families; distant at home; cynical toward police bureaucracy.

Driven homicide detective with moral fatigue, high cynicism, and deep identification with the mission. No cognitive decline or psychosis. Primary risks: burnout, family detachment, and alcohol misuse to blunt intrusive crime-scene memories.
